run_doctest_auto_ptr: run the doctest suite for boost python auto_ptr extension bindings
test_look_function: test the look function that reads an auto_ptr value without transferring ownership
test_steal_function: test the steal function that transfers auto_ptr ownership and returns the value
test_maybe_steal_function: test the maybe_steal function that conditionally transfers auto_ptr ownership based on a boolean flag
test_make_function: test the make function that creates and returns a new X object via auto_ptr
